lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight increase in density across the central ribcage area.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One minor bifurcation observed on the dorsal terminus of the third anterior line; all other lines maintain a linear, non-intersecting topology.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 1, 2, 11, and 12 are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the mid-ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally, forming a short semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent white spots are visible on the infraorbital region of the face, and a distinct white transverse band is present on the lower throat/neck junction.
